svg.title: An input shift of π/2 swaps the two absolute values
svg.desc: The graph of abs(sin x)+abs(cos x) repeats after pi/2; its minima occur exactly at multiples of pi/2.
svg.text: An input shift of π/2 swaps the two absolute values
At x = 0 the value is 1. At x = π/4 it is √2, so π/4 is not a period.
